verdict.rationale: Otter AI Chat is documented as searching across your meetings to answer questions in natural language. Natural-language search over past calls and transcripts across all time periods is also claimed, so the core cross-history Q&A is a first-party capability. However, nothing in the evidence shows that answers come with source citations or links back to the meeting or transcript, and every item is vendor marketing. missing for 10: documented source citations/attribution in answers, evidence of coverage across the entire meeting history within AI Chat itself, independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can ask questions in natural language across my whole meeting history ("what did we decide about pricing?") and get answers with sources

citations.quote: Otter AI Chat searches across your meetings and connected apps to instantly answer questions
Find key insights from past calls, documents, and more using natural-language.
Search your meeting transcripts across all time periods
